Comparison of ASRock and MSI DDR4 mother.description: MAG B660M MORTAR DDR4: Conquer the Battlefield Designed for gaming on the Intel B660 chipset (12th Gen Intel Core supported, LGA 1700), the MSI MAG B660M MORTAR DDR4 (Micro-ATX) motherboard includes premium GPU support with PCI-e 4.0 x16 and PCI-e 3.0 x16 slots (AMD CrossFire supported), improved DDR4 memory modules (4800+MHz/OC), and dual M.2 Gen4 storage slots (with Shield Frozr). To power 12th Gen Intel Core desktop processors, the MAG B660M MORTAR DDR4 is equipped with a 12 duet rail power system (60A, DrMOS) and dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, augmented with multiple passive cooling features. MSI B660 gaming motherboards feature durable PCBs with 2oz of thickened copper and PCI-e Steel Armor to support the primary graphics card slot. Connectivity includes 2.5G LAN ethernet, USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C (20Gbps), 4K/60Hz display support, and 7.1 HD audio. For gamers looking for a compact 12th Gen Intel Core micro-ATX platform with PCI-e 4.0 x16 graphics card architecture, improved DDR4 memory, and dual M.2 Gen4 storage slots, the MSI MAG B660M MORTAR DDR4 gaming motherboard is built to help conquer the battlefield.
